description: Provisional profile for the Frutiger Aero bubble house: mixed opaque shell, glass and emissive trim, exterior-only for the first delivery.

notes: First house is exterior-only with shallow interior backing.
Shell, glass, trim and emission use procedural Blender materials unless painted detail is specifically approved.

requirements.axes: Blender +Z up; glTF conversion and destination orientation verified
requirements.uv: UVs only where required by the chosen materials or bake path
requirements.geometry: Closed intended solids, real window/door openings and wall thickness
requirements.source: Editable Blender source preserved; bake/export processing happens on a copy

submaterials.emission: cyan emissive trim; support and fallback recorded

notes: Test one representative glass window before replicating it.
Do not bake reflections, lighting or shadows into base color.
Verify emissive strength extension support and provide a documented fallback.

textures.source: procedural Blender materials; bake/convert for glTF

limits: Provisional until the bubble house is modeled and tested.
Reference image 3 is copyrighted night-lit inspiration only; never a generation, projection or texture input.
No UDIM assumption in glTF delivery.
Exterior-only first scope; interiors, aquarium, animated bubbles, landscaping and spiral staircase are deferred.
